Letters

Bill Reichle for City Council

Tim and Marian Nelson · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

Editor,

We proudly support the candidacy of Bill Reichle for City Council. As Piedmont residents for nearly 50 years, we’ve always been grateful for the dedicated service of our elected public officials — the people who step up to run for challenging offices, and the people with the integrity and the competence so critically needed to get important community work done, and done right.

Bill Reichle has our enthusiastic support because he represents the finest example of one of those step-up people: Motivated by nothing more than a wish to give back to his community, he accepts no outside donations and is self-funding his campaign. Just as important, he brings to his candidacy a rare set of critical skills for the Council post — an even and generous personality, and an unequaled career background in administrative management. No surprise, then, that Reichle’s candidacy has been endorsed not only by Piedmont’s current mayor, but by eight former mayors, as well.

Beyond all that, Bill Reichle has developed a thoughtfully progressive program that emphasizes Public Safety, Fiscal Discipline, and Community Engagement. We urge you to check it out in detail at ReichleforPiedmont.com.

Tim and Marian Nelson 237 Scenic Avenue
